en: What flies in the sky and carries people?
A plane has wings and flies in the sky.
A boat floats and goes on water.
What has two wheels and pedals?
A bike has two wheels and you push the pedals.
What big vehicle takes lots of people along the road?
A bus carries lots of people on the road.
Firefighters drive a fire engine with a ladder and hoses.
What does a farmer drive in the field?
A farmer drives a tractor in the fields.
A rocket blasts off into space.
What slides down a snowy hill?
A sledge slides over the snow.
What has a siren and takes people to hospital?
An ambulance takes sick people to hospital.
What flies with spinning blades on top?
A helicopter has spinning blades on top.
What do you push with one foot, standing on it?
You stand on a scooter and push with one foot.
How many wheels does a car usually have?
A car usually has four wheels.
Where does a plane take off?
Planes take off and land at an airport.
Where does a train stop for people?
Trains stop at stations for people to get on and off.

example.q_en: What flies in the sky and carries people?
example.why_en: A plane has wings and flies in the sky.

en.title: Things that go
en.teach: Some things go on roads, some on rails, some on water and some in the sky. A boat goes on water, a plane flies.
